prompt: A cinematic film still captures the humid interior of a sprawling botanical greenhouse where lush ferns drape from iron rafters. On the left, an elderly woman in a floral apron stands beside a tall glass pane, her posture upright as she gently holds a watering can. Next to her, a young boy in a blue cap points excitedly at a vibrant orchid blooming on a wooden shelf. In the center, a man in a red scarf sits on a rustic bench, his legs crossed casually while he looks at a small notebook resting on his knee. Beside him, a brown dog lies on the tiled floor, its head resting peacefully on its paws. To the right, a girl in a yellow dress reaches out to touch the broad leaf of a monstera plant, her fingers barely grazing the green surface. Standing behind her, a woman in a white coat observes the interaction with a slight smile, her arms folded across her chest. Near the back wall, a teenager in a hoodie leans against a metal support beam, watching the scene unfold with detached interest. A black cat perches atop a nearby potting table, its tail twitching slowly as it stares intently at a fluttering butterfly near the ceiling. Scattered around the floor are three terracotta pots, one cracked and empty, another filled with soil, and the third holding a small succulent. There is no artificial lighting visible, relying solely on natural daylight filtering through the glass. There is no modern technology such as smartphones or tablets present in the frame.
